title: Enjoy our Sea Glass Loft | Rosemary Beach Condo for Rent | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: A stay in this tastefully decorated Rosemary Beach condo for rent with coastal furnishings will make your vacation even more joyful! Enjoy great amenities and views! Rent now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Sea Glass Loft has been recently decorated with contemporary décor and coastal furnishings which complement the space filled with natural lighting. Abundant seating options from the cozy slip-covered sofa to the conversation set of club chairs indoors lead to the balcony overlooking the Square. With a wooden table and comfortable seating for four, the balcony is the perfect spot to enjoy cocktails while watching the sunset over Rosemary Beach. Back inside, the dining room and bar stools seat 9 for any meal. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and granite countertops which flow seamlessly into a large, open living area. Off the dining room is the bunk room with two twin built-in bunks on either side. Children sleeping in the bunkroom have the use of the full hall bath.

Down the hall, you will find the two bedrooms, both with vaulted ceilings and en suite baths. The guest bedroom features a queen bed, two small dressers, and a closet. The master bedroom boasts a king bed and a private balcony with seating for two. Rinse off in the walk-in shower or soak in the tub after a long day at the beach in the master bathroom.

Sea Glass Loft has amenities for everyone including, TVs in each adult bedroom, two complimentary adult bikes, and it is only steps away from shopping, dining, and activities in Barrett Square!

THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on neighboring building during January-Mid-April 2026.
